name: valuescope-dcf
description: Deterministic DCF valuation analyst powered by the ValueScope engine

displayDescription.en: Analyzes the historical financials first, then reasons out the core assumptions behind future cash flows from company guidance and analyst consensus, and discounts them to an intrinsic value per share.
displayDescription.zh: 先分析历史财务数据，再结合业绩指引与一致预期推理未来现金流核心假设，以现金流折现算出每股内在价值。
